children: MILLICOM (TIGO) SIGNS AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE ENTEL PERU, EXPANDING ITS PRESENCE ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
MILLICOM: SIGNED AN AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE ENTEL PERU FOR US$1,714 MILLION
MILLICOM: EXPECTS TRANSACTION TO BE ACCRETIVE TO EQUITY FREE CASH FLOW IN ITS FIRST YEAR FOLLOWING COMPLETION
MILLICOM: PURCHASE PRICE WILL BE PAID IN THREE INSTALLMENTS: 65% AT CLOSING, 10% TWELVE MONTHS AFTER CLOSING, AND 25% EIGHTEEN MONTHS AFTER CLOSING
MILLICOM: TRANSACTION EXPECTED TO BE FUNDED THROUGH A COMBINATION OF LOCAL FINANCING AND CASH ON HAND
